Each deck follows its section page by page, with one slide for the idea behind a page
and one or two for its examples. A small label at the top of every slide names the
page, and links to it.

::: {#decks}
:::

## Presenting

The buttons at the bottom left open the contents, change the theme, turn the laser
pointer on and off, go full screen, and open the section on the course site.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Right arrow or space | Next slide |
| Left arrow | Previous slide |
| T | Change the theme (Light, Sand, Dark, Ocean, High contrast) |
| L | Laser pointer on or off |
| F | Full screen |
| S | Speaker view, with notes for every slide |
| O or Esc | Overview of all slides |
| ? | All keys |

To print a deck or save it as a PDF, add `?print-pdf` to its address and print from
the browser. Adding `?theme=dark` to the address opens a deck in that theme.
